text:
Predicates:
EatsSalads(x) ::: x eats salads regularly.
Conscious(x) ::: x is very conscious about their health and eating habits.
GrewUpHealthyHome(x) ::: x grew up in a health-conscious childhood home.
FulfilledIntake(x) ::: x fulfills their nutritional daily intakes.
GoodRelationship(x) ::: x has good relationships with their parents.
VisitedGym(x) ::: x visits the gym at least once a day.

Premises:
∀x (EatsSalads(x) → Conscious(x)) ::: All people who eat salads regularly are very conscious about their health and eating habits.
∀x (GrewUpHealthyHome(x) → EatsSalads(x)) ::: All people who grew up in health-conscious childhood homes eat salads regularly.
∀x (FulfilledIntake(x) → GrewUpHealthyHome(x)) ::: All people who fulfill their nutritional daily intakes grew up in health-conscious childhood homes.
∀x (GoodRelationship(x) → FulfilledIntake(x)) ::: If people have good relationships with their parents, then they fulfill their nutritional daily intakes.
∀x (GoodRelationship(x) → ¬EatsSalads(x)) ::: If people have good relationships with their parents, then they do not eat salads regularly.
∀x (VisitedGym(x) → FulfilledIntake(x)) ::: If people visit the gym at least once a day, then they always fulfill their daily nutritional intakes.
( (GrewUpHealthyHome(taylor) ∧ GoodRelationship(taylor)) ∨ (¬GrewUpHealthyHome(taylor) ∧ ¬GoodRelationship(taylor)) ) ::: It is either both true that Taylor grew up in a health-conscious childhood home and she has a good relationship with her parents, or both are false.

Conclusion:
EatsSalads(taylor) ::: Taylor eats salads regularly.
